workflow.critical: Communicate in {communication_language}. One bug per run. Reproduce before fixing. Smallest fix. Never mark Fixed without verification evidence.

step.action: Bug file = command argument; if none, read {output_folder}/test-results/bugs/BUGS-INDEX.md and ask which Open bug to fix
Reproduction browser is visible unless the user asked for headless

step.output: Status, root cause, files changed, verification, review result (found / fixed / open), commit id. Next: /aiqa-executetests to re-verify the file that found the bug.
